arrivalRitual.title: Choose how you begin together
arrivalRitual.promise: A beginning gives you somewhere to stand. It never decides what you may become.

originArrivalLines.GARDEN_MEADOW: Rain beads on the grass. The Hearth is close, and the grove opens gently beyond it.
originArrivalLines.COAST: Salt mist reaches even this inland gate. Slick stones teach the first careful steps.
originArrivalLines.MOUNTAIN: A cool updraft moves through the branches. The first climb asks you to look upward.
originArrivalLines.ISLAND: Warm rain gathers on root bridges. The first path bends around water before it rises.
originArrivalLines.DESERT: Dry wind crosses the Garden. Shade markers make the first outward route legible.
originArrivalLines.SNOWLAND: Snow catches on the leaves. Warmth markers turn the first journey into a route between shelters.
originArrivalLines.RANDOM: The Garden will choose a beginning for you. Whatever arrives changes the first lesson, not your potential.
